text.title: Code Review Cycle Procedure
text.summary: Step-by-step procedure for applying Code Review Cycle. Each step lists input, action, and output. Pause and surface the artefact when output is produced. Folds in the former workflow file: Step-by-step review pipeline, SDD task completion checkpoints, reflexion learning loop integration, and best practices for authors, reviewers, and teams. The checkpoint and reflexion blocks are in `content/05-examples.xml`.

step.name: ai-prescreen
step.action: Run AI lint + anti-pattern + test-coverage check.

step.name: merge-and-dedup
step.action: Unify lists; deduplicate; rank by severity.

step.name: human-on-block-and-writeback
step.action: Human resolves BLOCKs; novel patterns/mistakes written back.

decision-gate.p: After the final step, the artefact MUST satisfy the output contract in content/02-output-contract.xml before downstream consumers read it.

section.title: Pipeline at a glance
section.p: The full review pipeline after task execution:

list.item: 2. PR creation with AI pre-review (Level 1 pass)
3. Automated CI/CD checks (lint, tests, security scan)
5. Human review (peer/senior) with AI explanations available

section.p: Steps 1-3 above are pipeline items 2-4, step 4 is items 5-8.

list.item: Authors: self-review with AI first before pushing; keep PRs small; mark AI-generated code for extra scrutiny
Reviewers: review AI suggestions before deep dive; focus on what AI misses (business logic, architecture); do not rubber-stamp AI approvals
Teams: configure AI to team-specific standards (custom ruff/eslint); track false positive rate quarterly; tune if rate exceeds 20%
